sentences.en: Some of the students decorated the classroom with Christmas ornaments.
sentences.zh: 一些学生用圣诞装饰品装饰了教室。

sentences.en: Friends who pay a visit are an ornament to the home.
sentences.zh: 来访的朋友让家里更加有生气。

sentences.en: I buy at least one new Christmas tree ornament every year.
sentences.zh: 我每年至少都会买一个新圣诞树装饰品。
